result: Implemented exact-Workstream capability-change recomposition with dead-control removal, safe-content preservation, return restoration, and a bounded transient notification.
implementation: Capability-change events are accepted only under exact Workstream/attachment authority and non-stale projection/layout revisions.
One canonical projection refresh removes ineligible controls and contributions while preserving remaining eligible content and presentation state.
Capability return is detected from canonical contribution restoration; no local eligibility is inferred.
Loss notification is bounded, transient, and never rendered as a permanent unavailable panel.
acceptance: Capability loss creates no permanent unavailable panel and return restores eligible contribution.
Canvas/TUI switching, hide/show, Desktop restart, daemon reconnect, and contribution recomposition retain required exact-authority and presentation invariants.
